segments.text: We first tried E-commerce platform in 208. At the time, market pressure mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Maiduguri, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after E-commerce platform—we saw Faster order fulfillment within 11 months.
Policy-wise, Tax compliance shaped our move. We adjusted by Use interns/NYSC.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
